title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Earning Rate Schedule
content:
Each tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club earns at its own rate. The earn rate is the number of spendable points earned per US dollar of qualifying spend. The tier bonus is the percentage bonus added to base accruals for holding the tier. The partner rate is the percentage of the platform earn rate applied to partner activity, and it is read only where activity with earning partners outside the platform accrues points at all for that tier.

## Rates

| Tier | Spendable points per US dollar | Tier bonus, per cent | Partner earning | Partner rate, per cent of the platform rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | 2 | 0 | not permitted | 0 |
| Wanderlane Silver | 3 | 10 | permitted | 50 |
| Wanderlane Gold | 4 | 25 | permitted | 75 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | 5 | 50 | permitted | 100 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | 6 | 75 | permitted | 100 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | 8 | 100 | permitted | 125 |

## Bonus awards

The milestone figure is the qualifying points at which a milestone bonus is paid within a period, and the milestone bonus is the spendable points paid when that figure is reached. The birthday bonus is the spendable points paid once a year on the member's birthday. The referral bonus is the spendable points paid for each new member referred and enrolled, and the referral cap is the largest number of referrals that may be paid in one calendar year.

| Tier | Milestone figure, qualifying points | Milestone bonus, points | Birthday bonus, points | Referral bonus, points | Referrals payable a year |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | 0 | 0 | 0 | 500 | 3 |
| Wanderlane Silver | 20000 | 2500 | 500 | 1000 | 5 |
| Wanderlane Gold | 40000 | 7500 | 1000 | 2000 | 8 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | 80000 | 15000 | 2500 | 3000 | 12 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | 140000 | 30000 | 5000 | 5000 | 20 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | 250000 | 60000 | 10000 | 8000 | 40 |

## Points of judgement on the schedule

*At which figure does a Wanderlane Titanium member's milestone bonus fall due?* At a qualifying count of 140000 within the period, and the bonus paid is 30000 spendable points.

*What does the partner rate of Wanderlane Gold mean against its earn rate?* Wanderlane Gold earns 4 spendable points per US dollar on the platform, and its partner rate is 75 per cent of that platform rate.
